About Me

I am a Mechatronics Engineering student-K25 at Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology (HCMUT - VNU-HCM).

Skills & Interests

Core Technical Skills: Mechatronics system design, embedded systems, robotics, control systems, and hardware-software integration.

Interests: Rapid prototyping, cross-domain problem solving, learning new technologies on the fly, and exploring space and Earth observation systems.
